LanguageData.IR_LetterTextReformIdeo:
{0} is ready to reform!

You may make one gameplay change: add or remove a meme, change the structure or one precept, or edit one ritual or role. Settings belonging to the same ritual or role can be changed together.

Names, descriptions, colors, icons and styles can be changed freely. Any changes required by your chosen meme won’t count against your reform.

You’ll review everything before spending your development points, and you can go back or reset your changes.

Open {0} in the Ideoligions tab to begin.{1}
